Solution

Control + Visibility → Trusted Delivery: know what was required, decided and done.

Control

Evaluate agreed requirements as review and ticket evidence changes. Keep exceptions visible, assigned and actionable.

Requirements → evaluations → findings → responsible follow-up
Visibility

Retain time-stamped evidence of what the system recorded. Explain what is known, what changed, and what remains unknown.

One evidence record → attention, briefs, reports and investigations

Competition

Agents can automate the task. Who maintains the decisions, evidence and follow-up over time?

CategoryOverlap / focusWarestack focus / implication
CodeRabbit / Qodo AI review, PR analysis and configurable code-review checks We focus on delivery requirements, ownership and the decisions around the change.
Claude / Cursor / gh-aw ↗ Scheduled agents, GitHub-event workflows, reporting and custom automation Comparable systems can be built. Warestack packages retained state, evaluation and follow-up.
GitHub / Mergify ↗ Rulesets, required checks, approvals and merge mechanics Works with existing gates; interprets supported requirements as evidence changes.
Vanta / Drata Compliance controls, audit workflows and evidence review Supplies engineering change evidence; does not determine SOC 2 compliance.
Harness ↗CI/CD, AI review, policy gates, approvals and delivery automationSignificant overlap. Win on focused adoption and proven operational reliability.
Warestack Maintained evidence, scoped evaluations, finding lifecycle and accountable follow-up. Control + Visibility → Trusted Delivery
The question is not whether agents can reproduce a feature. It is correctness, freshness, operating effort and sustained value.
